projects.title: Customer Onboarding Platform
projects.challenge: A U.S. financial institution needed a bilingual, mobile-first onboarding platform to support new customer acquisition, in a confidential financial-services environment.
highlights: Leading front-end development of the platform with Next.js and TypeScript
Building financial integrations and automated workflows across n8n, MuleSoft and Q2, making independent architectural and integration decisions
Refactored Headless CMS integrations and implemented caching strategies, cutting infrastructure costs and improving scalability
Raised automated test coverage to a mandatory minimum of 90% while eliminating SonarQube code smells
Improved CI/CD reliability and deployment workflows with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
projects.results: Service requests reduced from 3.29M to 34K per month, and test coverage raised from 17% to 90%

projects.title: Vivo Fibra Lite
projects.challenge: Launch a new telecom sales platform for optical fiber internet with credit-card billing, from zero to production.
highlights: Owned all front-end architectural decisions end to end
Defined best practices for code quality, testing and performance; reviewed PRs and enforced HOC/Composition patterns and coding standards
Implemented unit and mutation testing with Jest and Stryker Mutator
Managed data fetching and caching with React Query for a fast, resilient UX
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with ArgoCD on Kubernetes, with Grafana for monitoring and observability
Integrated Stackspot AI to create custom agents, knowledge sources and quick commands with VSCode integration
projects.results: 1,000,000+ visits per month and over R$100K in monthly revenue

projects.title: Vitrine
projects.challenge: Natura and Avon needed a consultant platform able to handle very high traffic from millions of active consultants.
highlights: Led development of Vitrine, the high-traffic consultant platform
Optimized performance, quality and reliability under heavy load
Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams to deliver a high-impact solution
projects.results: Scaled to 100K+ requests per minute for 6 million active consultants

projects.title: Multi-country E-commerce
projects.challenge: Expand an e-commerce platform to new markets with country-specific localization.
highlights: Expanded and localized the platform for the UK, Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands and Bolivia
Implemented unit and behavior-driven tests to keep releases safe across markets
projects.results: Launched in 5 countries, increasing sales and profitability

projects.title: Driveway
projects.challenge: Improve the online vehicle sales experience on a U.S. platform.
highlights: Built high-quality, reusable Design System components used across the sales experience
Investigated and resolved critical bugs, ensuring product stability
Managed release cycles and contributed to continuous deployment workflows
Implemented unit and behavioral tests with Jest and Playwright

projects.title: Broker Management & Invoicing
projects.challenge: An insurance company needed a broker-management system for quotations, policies and contract issuance, plus invoice and financial workflows.
highlights: Built the architecture and features of the broker-management system with ReactJS, Redux and Context API
Developed invoice management and financial workflow features running on AWS
projects.results: Around R$1 billion in invoices processed

Welcome to Atirson Dev 💻

Focusing on real technology, real projects, and best development practices. No Pokedex clones or purposeless tutorials — the goal is to go beyond the obvious, creating useful and well-structured content to level up your dev skills.
